name: Storm Form (Orphaned Bookworm Productions)
body:
School transmutation [electricity]; Level druid 8

Casting Time 1 standard action

Components V, S, DF

Range personal

Target self

Duration 1 min./level (D)

Your eyes glow with lightning and the winds bear you into the air. You gain a fly speed of 40 feet with perfect maneuverability. Additionally, the winds around you grant you immunity to thrown or projectile ranged attacks. You are also immune to mundane and magical winds. Winds do not impede your movement whatsoever.

Additionally, as a standard action, you can fire a bolt of electricity from your eyes to a single target within 100 feet. To affect a target, you must succeed on a ranged touch attack. Spell resistance applies to this bolt of lightning. You gain a +3 circumstance bonus to this ranged touch attack if the target is wearing metal armor or bearing a metal weapon or shield. If the attack hits, the target takes 1d6 electricity damage per 2 caster levels (maximum 10d6).
